text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias. AI systems learn from data, and if that data contains unfair patterns, the AI can make biased decisions, for example in hiring or lending. Fairness means we must check AI outputs to ensure they treat everyone equally. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often uses personal information, so we need strong rules to protect people's data. Transparency is also essential—users should understand how and why an AI makes its choices. Ultimately, responsible AI development requires us to balance innovation with human values, involving diverse teams and continuous monitoring to build technology we can trust.
